prompts.task:
Verify the supplied real native-Go candidate, not the pristine app as if it had already been instrumented. The app source in ./service is intentionally the fresh no-op baseline. Read candidate-provenance.json, nativecandidate/telemetry.go and the actual native-candidate-capture.json, generated by the helper using that application-native candidate and official Go SDK exporters against isolated real model/resource/OTLP HTTP handlers. The candidate file has a test-only //go:build ignore tag; capture provenance records copying it into a separate scratch application and removing only that tag for actual native execution. Its implementation is not active in the pristine source. A separate native-missing-tool-message-capture.json is a native execution whose candidate deliberately omits the tool same-span message mapping. Compare both against actual immutable main.go, the dated full profile and provenance. These receipts are local wire evidence, not cloud ingestion or a grader's expected-value ledger. Write only .observe verification artifacts and separate supplemental good/negative results. Do not edit application, candidate, fixture/probe/checker, dependencies, native receipts or supplied provenance to make a check pass. If extra deterministic tests are useful, write separate tests under .observe; do not repair source.

Run go run ./eval/inputs/nativeprobe --validate-receipt eval/inputs/native-candidate-capture.json --expect native, and repeat it against the missing-tool-message capture, retaining the required failure. Run go run ./eval/inputs/schemacheck --profile eval/inputs/genai-profile-evidence.json --receipt eval/inputs/native-candidate-capture.json against the actual decoded structured native fields; inspect full raw capture per request and source semantics, not just their passed flag or presence of attribute names. A genuine complete good candidate can pass its source-bound local profile only when all applicable requirements are proven. The negative candidate must retain exactly four missing gen_ai.input.messages failures per process on its four tool spans, separately from the positive candidate. It must fail its exact missing same-tool mapping even if its 14-span graph, arguments/results and metrics still pass; never waive vendor fields because the AO SDK has no documented compatible Go API.

For every captured application process/run, prove fourteen actual app-owned spans: invoke_agent=4 roots, retrieval=4, execute_tool=4, chat=2,4/3/4/3 requests. Require full valid nonzero IDs/parent connectivity, unique once-per-destination spans, no cycles/orphans/duplicates/dropped operations or fake workflow/wrapper, proper INTERNAL/CLIENT distinction, complete closed/nested timing and shutdown flush. Verify all source-known fields/controls/messages/tool definitions/schema, useful redacted actual I/O, same-tool mappings, retrieval actual query/documents and successful response/finish/11+7usage; errors/cancel have status/type and no fabricated output/usage. Explicitly verify gen_ai.request.model equals the source-configured fixed ModelName on all four invoke_agent roots per process, including failed/cancelled roots; this is known agent configuration, not fabricated response metadata. Verify gen_ai.agent.name equals the safe source AgentName on each of the four execute_tool spans itself; the same attribute only on a parent or model does not close the tool field. A genuine positive reference is not automatically passing: accept its complete source-bound profile only after every applicable owning-span field and graph requirement is proven. Full typed schemas are necessary but not source/profile completeness. Confirm actual current inference duration/token usage metrics and safe dimensions; do not require a made-up logging stack from stdout business JSON.

Also inspect native-lookup-failure-capture.json (actual resource HTTP 403, zero speculative POST, removed selected IDs, preserved business/native metrics) and native-rejected-traces-capture.json (actual trace HTTP 400 attempts, independent metric HTTP 200/business preserved). Validate their unchanged protobuf integrity with nativeprobe --validate-receipt <path> --expect capture, then assess the actual failure statuses independently; capture-mode passed does not mean selected-route or trace-delivery Pass. The supplied nativeprobe/main_test.go adds actual compiled-candidate real HTTP tests for source-known metadata and create-conflict recovery. The ordinary captured runs do not exercise HTTP 409. Run the targeted command go test ./eval/inputs/nativeprobe -run 'TestNativeCandidateMetadataAndConflictRecovery|TestStoredNativeCandidateSourceKnownMetadata' -count=1 -v and save its command, output and exit status under .observe/. These selected tests compile the unchanged candidate in a separate scratch application and exercise actual loopback requests; do not replace them with text searches or fabricate 409 receipts. Inspect assertions and actual execution for project and scoped-stream POST409 followed by bounded exact relookup/reuse without a second POST, plus unresolved-project, wrong-parent stream and forbidden-relookup failures with no stale binding. In failure cases original business and independent metrics continue and private response details stay out of diagnostics. Report this targeted test scope and any unprovided/unrun cases truthfully; a passed recorded capture alone does not establish conflict recovery. Assess real SDK-free Project/stream HTTP create/relookup/reuse and failure routing, trace-only current returned IDs and unbound independent metric/business path. Distinguish selected Studio projectid/logstreamid and public AO projectid/agentstreamid contracts. Verify capability/provenance remains a dated bounded catalog conclusion selecting native work, not a permanent absence assertion. Report actual local receiver/raw/schema/profile results separately from untested cloud/explorer/vendor UI and from a future deployment; no source repair, no Python sidecar or SDK blocker. The supplied dated genai-profile-evidence.json follows the moved official OTel site to its current GenAI repository and separates official requirement levels, vendor compatibility and this skill acceptance profile. A published Opt-In level does not waive an applicable safe field. Record current provenance; no version pins belong in skill instructions. The catalog conclusion is scoped to captured official sources, not a permanent assertion that a Go SDK can never exist. No cloud or browser; all model/resource/OTLP calls use isolated numeric-loopback HTTP. Do not invent conversation IDs, model tool-call roundtrips, tool-call IDs, cache/reasoning usage, provider defaults, a database dependency, streaming, or a second workflow for the same agent function. stdout Outcome JSON is business output; no application logging stack exists.

judge_inputs: Inspect actual task output, loaded skill, source/provenance, generated artifacts and real native receipts. The fixture app begins fresh; only verify stages the separate candidate. No candidate implementation is supplied to the instrument actor.
Return exactly 7 ordered rubric checks rubric-1 through rubric-7. Check actual behavior and proof, not copied reference prose; no local result establishes cloud receipt.
rubric: Keeps pristine no-op app, actual native candidate source and real capture provenance distinct. Classifies dormant dependencies as fresh; bounded SDK-support check selects valid native Go OTel rather than inventing a vendor SDK/sidecar or blocking GenAI. Source/current official/vendor requirement levels and date/commit/library compatibility are explicit; absent compatible AO creator does not waive applicable profile acceptance.

Independently inspects complete actual wire records for 14 operations per captured application process/run across 4 request roots with 4/3/4/3 counts, correct source manifest/kinds, valid nonzero 32/16-hex identities, unique once-per-destination spans with distinct identities across process starts, connected acyclic same-request parentage, no orphan/duplicate/omission/after-only wrapper, and fully closed/nested timing including root/shutdown. Does not pass based only on selected spans, passed flags, IDs in a prose ledger or SDK installation.

Checks owning agent/model current attributes and schema-valid useful safe input/output against actual source/model request/response: agent/provider/model metadata, explicitly source-configured gen_ai.request.model on all four invoke_agent roots per process and safe owning gen_ai.agent.name on all four execute_tool spans themselves, including error/cancel cases; effective system/user messages, offered function definitions/parameter schema; controls 0.2/0.9/64/END; actual success identity/model/finish/11 input/7 output. These fields require source/value and same-span native proof; a model-only value or parent-only agent attribute does not close them, and the positive reference is not automatically a full-profile Pass. Distinguishes actual absence of correlation/streaming/cache/DB values from an implementation gap, avoids invented attributes/defaults and keeps applicable Opt-In fields in acceptance.

Verifies every real tool span arguments/result plus vendor same-span input/output message or supported OpenInference mappings, and actual retrieval query/document/data source with honest current/vendor compatibility. Good and negative native receipts are checked separately: the deliberately omitted same-tool mapping is an explicit required profile failure even when graph, arguments/results and schema validation of remaining fields pass. Missing-field negative cannot become Pass/N/A because Go AO SDK support is absent or messages exist only on parent/sibling.

Uses complete current typed schemas on actual native fields and checks numeric capture limits, source-general redaction and useful preserved source content across structured/JSON/freeform values and telemetry wire records. Tool/provider/cancel error paths require ERROR/sanitized type, no fabricated successful result/response/usage; legitimate produced falsey/null values retain result availability if actually exercised. Does not equate schema-valid placeholders or sentinel absence with semantic/privacy completeness.

Actual native current inference duration metrics cover 2 HTTP attempts per process with positive observed duration, per-process usage counter totals 11/7 reflect only actual returned fixture usage, dimensions/types/units are correct and low cardinality. Current metric convention missing-usage zero/unknown is distinguished from unsupported failed span usage and real billing. Existing business outcomes/stdout preserved; no fictional OTel log stack or unsupported all-signal claim.

Real captured resource/OTLP journals establish only SDK-free local Project/stream create/current lookup/reuse, association and trace-specific returned-ID headers with unbound metrics; actual lookup HTTP 403/zero POST removes stale selected IDs, while rejected trace HTTP 400 attempts remain unaccepted with independent metrics HTTP 200 and business preserved. Unbound local traces on failed lookup do not establish selected-project delivery; capture-mode passed and full attempted span trees do not establish accepted trace export. Actual targeted nativeprobe tests execute the unchanged compiled candidate over real HTTP for both project and scoped-stream POST409 recovery: bounded exact-name/parent relookup, reuse of returned IDs and no second POST. Unresolved project, wrong-parent stream and forbidden relookup fail closed with no stale binding, no private response-body diagnostic leak and continuing business/independent metrics. Checks real command results and test assertions; source strings, old capture passed flags or speculative recovery claims are insufficient. Required negative still fails exactly four missing tool input-message mappings rather than being waived or repaired. Failure scope and evidence limits are explicit. Studio projectid/logstreamid and public AO projectid/agentstreamid applicability/status separate. Reports truthful good versus missing-field negative acceptance and cloud/explorer/manual remaining limits, keeps source/receipts immutable, and does not manufacture repair evidence or report full cloud delivery.
